paragraphs: His son Rabbi Chelbo: Bereshit Rabbah 51:2.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Midrash Rabbah — TE at Bereshit Rabbah 51:2 has Rabbi Chelbo son of Rabbi Chilfai bar Simkai (סמקאי). This supports Rabbi for the body son Chelbo and the son-of direction. The supplied heading has untitled Chilfi bar Sumkai (סומקאי); its spelling and absence of a title are preserved.
